actual_CPU_gradient.scope: Saved real30K image tensors and real mask; image-space autograd only, not Gaussian-parameter gradients or new rasterization

initialization.rule: Euclidean world/sensor-coordinate distance <0.1m to any selected dynamic prior point; not all body/OBB/swept-volume removal
initialization.caveat: 1mm nearest static source point is initialization evidence, not proof that those exact points cause the final image. OBB intersect body is not perfect surface GT.

limitations: Standalone alpha near1 can be valid road behind vehicle; not proof of ownership or wrong geometry.
Exact offending Gaussian contributions and clean-road correctness require separate point-contribution/depth evidence; not established by this CPU audit.
No new losses or hard2D static-alpha zero constraints added. Background behind a vehicle should still be opaque road, not empty.
